i had to fix one more thing. now try it again
The weather in Glasgow, KY is clear with a temperature of 15.75 degrees Celsius, 53% humidity, and a wind speed of 10.36 m/s.
awesome, we will call that tool fixed

The weather tool is marked as fixed based on the successful result for Glasgow, KY. I ran a self-awareness check, and it shows that there's an active task to modify the tool, specifically concerning `ai_assistant.c`, but the process has faced challenges, including failing critic reviews and unknown errors. Several code modifications were generated, but some were rejected because they were identical to the existing code or didn't offer a solution to the problem.
